Called in `traversing()` right where the scenario nominates the fixture source repository as the canonical target, with os.getgid() (the gid the fixture configures as the workspace group). Four focused unit cases (run under umask 077): restrictive umask leaves the bits out and the helper puts exactly them back; only those bits change (0o2700→0o2730; 0o775 stays), idempotent; the product predicate's terms hold; foreign gid fails. `import stat` added. Not run: the whole test_stage_execution module / tools-pure group (their fixtures use disposable Git beyond the two approved cases; outside the exception) — reviewer's selection.
